home.tagline: A UI system for teams that ship with people and agents.
home.description: FewUI is an interface company. Components, design tokens, Cursor rules, and agent skills share one language — so products stay consistent from admin panels to guest experiences.
home.aboutBody: Built so product teams stop reinventing UI on every screen. A shared component and token language lets design, engineering, and AI agents work from the same rules.

aboutPoints.components: Mature components for panels, forms, dialogs, tables, and ops surfaces
aboutPoints.tokens: Runtime theming with light / dark and brand tokens
aboutPoints.agents: Cursor rules and skills so agents speak the same UI language
aboutPoints.ship: Proven in production: less one-off CSS, faster iteration

home.systemBody: FewUI is more than a component gallery. Theme tokens, accessible controls, form rows, and panel chrome are designed together — so new features do not break the language.

systemPoints.preview: Live preview: see your theme on real components instantly
systemPoints.export: Export rules and skills into your Cursor / agent workflow
systemPoints.scale: Same language from a small landing page to a dense ops panel

home.createTitle: Create a theme for your next project
home.createBody: In Create, tune color, type, and style tokens; preview components live; then pull rules and a skill pack into your project.
home.projectsBody: See how the kit holds up in production on the projects page — flagship products and use cases live there.
